scope: Dedicated appearance autosave candidate validation, STRICT commit, exact requested/applied accounting and downstream axes initialization. No general rollback framework or public preset API change.

candidate.validation: Every appearance-scoped key has a pure validator; unknown keys, invalid values, unavailable reference identities and future preset schema are rejected before import. Existing documented legacy aliases, optional descriptor defaults, retired keys and identity migration are explicit normalizations/exclusions. appVersion remains informational.
candidate.references: Resolve against a private reference controller and normalized saved library; carry retained user definitions into the commit. Never prune requested identities silently.
candidate.commit: One existing importer call after preparation; read back every canonical requested setting and reference exactly. A shortfall is failure even when the underlying importer returns ok:true.
candidate.axes: Initialize the startup axes default before capturing Defaults and restoring. Later gizmo wiring only reads the committed value.

matrix.postStartupReadback: Every requested value in the positive controls and exact Defaults after failures; axes-off remains off.
matrix.preservation: All37 failures preserve the original storage bytes and make zero autosave writes after a later appearance edit.
matrix.notice: All37 failures retain the initial short hint past the real hide deadline, fit the short/full notices at390x850, preserve the durable Looks notice across mode changes and edits. A different transient hint still expires.
matrix.normalDOM: Four controls have no failure notice ID.

validationLimits: The injection matrix proves #25. Characterization is separate rendering/identity regression coverage and cannot prove restoration correctness.
